title: 기념일 챙기기: 결혼기념일과 어버이날
objective: By the end, you can use ten words about family special days (wedding anniversaries, Parents' Day, gifts, celebrating) in short sentences.
summary: Learn ten everyday words for Korean family special days, such as wedding anniversaries and Parents' Day.

task.title: Use the special-day words
task.line: Choose, write, or complete each sentence with a word from this worksheet.

words.meaning: a special day you remember every year (anniversary, birthday, etc.)
words.example: 우리 집은 가족 기념일을 달력에 적어 둬요.
words.exampleMeaning: Our family writes our special family days on the calendar.

words.example: 다음 주가 부모님 결혼기념일이라서 케이크를 주문했어요.
words.exampleMeaning: Next week is my parents' wedding anniversary, so I ordered a cake.

words.meaning: Parents' Day, a day to thank your parents
words.example: 어버이날에는 멀리 살아도 부모님께 꼭 전화를 드려요.
words.exampleMeaning: On Parents' Day, I always call my parents, even though I live far away.

words.meaning: to remember a special day and do something for it
words.exampleMeaning: My husband remembers even the small special days and does something for them.

words.example: 친구들이 결혼기념일 축하 메시지를 보내 줬어요.
words.exampleMeaning: My friends sent me messages congratulating me on my wedding anniversary.

words.meaning: carnation (the flower given to parents and teachers)
words.example: 아이가 학교에서 만든 카네이션을 엄마 옷에 달아 줬어요.
words.exampleMeaning: The child pinned a carnation made at school onto Mom's clothes.

words.meaning: pocket money; spending money (given to someone, e.g., by or to family)
words.example: 올해는 선물 대신 부모님께 용돈을 드렸어요.
words.exampleMeaning: This year I gave my parents money instead of a gift.
On special days, our family usually eats out together.
On my way home from work, I bought a bouquet for my wife.
I forgot our wedding anniversary, so my wife got angry.

exercises: Choose the right word: ① 오늘은 집에서 요리하지 말고 ( 외식 / 용돈 )하자. ② 설날에 할아버지께 ( 외식 / 용돈 )을 받았어요.
Write the word from the list that matches each description: ① 자녀가 부모님께 감사하는 날 ② 부부가 결혼한 날을 매년 기억하는 날 ③ 축하할 때 주는, 꽃 여러 송이를 묶은 것
Fill in the blank with one word: 승진 ____드려요!
Choose the right word: 할머니께 ( 카네이션 / 기념일 )을 달아 드렸어요.
Fill in the blank with the correct form of 챙기다: 제 동생은 친구들 생일을 한 번도 안 잊고 잘 ____.
Complete the sentence with the past form of 잊어버리다: 회사 일이 너무 바빠서 친구 생일을 ____.
answers: ① 어버이날 ② 결혼기념일 ③ 꽃다발
